# navikt/fp-context

> Navigational hub and cross-cutting policy authority for Foreldrepenger AI context across all downstream repositories.

This hub serves as the primary grounding point for AI assistants, IDE agents, and GitHub Copilot spaces operating within Team Foreldrepenger (@navikt/teamforeldrepenger). It translates Norwegian legal frameworks (Folketrygdloven Kap. 14) into software architectural concepts and dictates standards for the application stack.

## Citizen-Facing Applications

- [Planlegger URL Guide](planlegger/url-guide.md): How to construct a deep-link URL to the parental leave planner (planlegger) — JSON context fields, valid enum values, lz-string compression, worked examples. **Use when** a user wants a clickable/visual link to a pre-configured plan.

## Core Context & Domain

- [Domain and Business Context](domain/business-context.md): Folketrygdloven kap. 14 legal basis, the value chain, and core benefit concepts. **Use when** you need the legal basis or the difference between foreldrepenger, engangsstønad, and svangerskapspenger.
- [Legal History](domain/legal-history.md): Significant rule changes, effective dates, source links, and fp-sak rule-set concepts. **Use when** an answer depends on *when* a rule changed (e.g. dekningsgrad/quota changes) or its effective date.
- [Domain Glossary](domain/glossary.md): Bidirectional mapping of Norwegian domain terms to codebase concepts. **Use when** you hit an unfamiliar domain term or need the code concept behind it (prevents hallucination).
- [Planning Heuristics](domain/planning-heuristics.md): Citizen-facing planning guidance — barnehage timing, dekningsgrad by birth month, employer coordination, gap-bridging, related benefits. **Use when** helping a citizen plan their leave (Norway / kap. 14 only).

## Architecture & Technology Stack

- [System Overview](architecture/system-overview.md): Repository tier classification, data flow, and NAIS deployment mapping. **Use when** you need the repo map or where something runs/fits.
- [Backend Stack](architecture/backend-stack.md): Java ecosystem — Jetty, Jersey, Weld (CDI), Hibernate, Jackson. **Use when** writing or reviewing backend Java.
- [Backend Auth](architecture/backend-auth.md): Incoming request authentication and authorization. **Use when** working on auth/authz in a backend app.
- [Frontend Stack](architecture/frontend-stack.md): React, Aksel design system, React Hook Form, TanStack. **Use when** writing or reviewing frontend code.

## Code Conventions & Workflows

- [Java Codestyle](conventions/java-codestyle.md): Functional and fluent paradigms, Java 25+ idioms. **Use when** writing or reviewing Java.
- [Engineering Workflow](conventions/workflow.md): Trunk-based development, Pull Request standards, CI/CD validation gates. **Use when** branching, opening a PR, or unsure about the workflow.
- [Testing Mechanisms](conventions/testing.md): Unit tests (per repo) vs integration setups (fp-autotest). **Use when** deciding where a test belongs or how to run it.
- [Copilot Instructions Template](conventions/copilot-instructions-template.md): Template and conventions for spoke repo `.github/copilot-instructions.md`. **Use when** creating or updating a spoke repo's Copilot instructions.

## Operations & Infrastructure

- [CI/CD Pipelines](operations/ci-cd.md): fp-gha-workflows, SonarCloud analytics, NAIS platform targets. **Use when** touching CI/CD or build/deploy config.
- [Dependency Management](operations/dependency-management.md): fp-bom governance and Dependabot lifecycles. **Use when** adding or upgrading a dependency.

## Optional

- [Contribution Guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md): AI-first, data-dense, table-centric layout rules and length budgets. **Use when** editing files in this hub.
- [Companion repo: Citizen apps](https://github.com/navikt/foreldrepengesoknad): Monorepo for all citizen-facing applications (open + login). **Use when** working on planlegger, søknad, or other frontend apps.
- [Companion repo: GitHub Actions](https://github.com/navikt/fp-gha-workflows): Reusable workflows and composite actions referenced by this hub.
- [Companion repo: Java BOM](https://github.com/navikt/fp-bom): Version pins, Jakarta EE 11 platform declarations, parent POM.
- [Companion repo: fp-felles](https://github.com/navikt/fp-felles): Core shared Java components used across backend microservices. **Use when** you might reinvent something that belongs in shared code (e.g. Jackson setup).
